comments: Chosen assumptions: ego makes a scripted left lateral evasion after 2 s at 8-9 m/s while agent1 is approximately abreast in the lane to its left, with a longitudinal offset of -1 to 1 m and the same target speed. Agent1 responds after 0.3-0.5 s by escaping into a third lane farther left. Three coexisting same-direction lanes are required, including the lane left of agent1. Ego initiates; agent1 responds. Seven-second horizon; no collision is required.
